title: BuiltinCommands
description: PipesHub's built-in /commands (SLASH2 §2.4): the one registry the composer's menu, the reserved command names (Python and TypeScript) and the docs are generated from. A built-in is a shortcut to a PipesHub feature; none ever reaches an executor as /text (S0). Generated as BUILTIN_COMMANDS in every target.

reservedWords.description: Words no user command may take, though PipesHub has no command for them: terminal-only commands and vendor commands with no PipesHub feature. Never listed; typing one shows a hint (O8).

kind.description: client: the browser does it with the APIs the UI already uses; server: it calls a route that reads or changes run, session or workspace state; prompt: a PipesHub-owned template expanded into the turn's text.

group.description: The menu group (SLASH3 §3.9): general is Built-in; sandbox is the Sandbox group, listed whole after Built-in. Absent means general.

package.description: The package that builds it: SLASH2 (C0–C4, §4) or SLASH3 (SB0–SB4, the sandbox commands), or GIT-FLOW (GF1, WP-26: `/repo`).

shipped.description: Listed in the menu. A planned command is reserved but not listed, so the menu never offers what does nothing.

executors.description: Where it works: any (it never touches the executor), else the durable loop, opencode, Codex, Claude Code and the classic chat path.

needs.description: What must hold for it to apply; otherwise the menu greys it out with the reason (O8). runCode: the chat may run code (`pipeshub@sandbox/run_code` granted and not denied); owner: the viewer owns the chat; engineChoice: the chat can choose its coding engine (Agent mode, or an agent whose profile lists several).

duringRun.description: While a reply is running (O7): now acts at once; next applies to the next message; wait is greyed out until the run ends.

args.description: The argument hint shown for the active row; empty when it takes none.

i18n.description: The translation key prefix: <i18n>.description, and <i18n>.reason.* for its greyed-out reasons.
